title: Relative entropy of entanglement and tripartite minimal surface
abstract: Proposes E_R(rho_AB) = [Area(Gamma_min) - Area(gamma_AB)]/4G_N with Gamma_min the minimal bulk tripartition surface. Proves the upper bound for general random tensor networks via a separable state built on Gamma_min; proves the matching lower bound for networks of one, two and three Haar-random tensors. Tripartition surfaces can form a tri-junction.
key_claims: Holographic E_R = tripartition-surface area minus RT area at leading order
Rigorous in small Haar-random networks; upper bound for general RTN
relevance_note: Abstract only. Another entropic (state-functional) quantity given a minimal-surface dual in random tensor networks; context for HYP-033's Haar control and for the trunk-question distinction between state functionals and network-sensitive observables. No finite-chi optimized-network content.
